item.title: DAVID MARCUS: Rich men north of Richmond try to steal votes of rural Virginians
item.summary: Virginia's special election on April 21 could transform redistricting into a class war, echoing Oliver Anthony's "Rich Men North of Richmond" anthem.

item.title: Doctors expose ‘buffalo hump’ as potential sign of hidden health conditions
item.summary: A fatty bulge at the base of the neck, known as a buffalo hump, can sometimes signal an underlying health condition, experts warn. Here's what to know.

item.title: Costco travel perks that could quietly save you hundreds on your next trip this spring
item.summary: Costco members may access expanded travel perks in 2026, including bundled hotel pricing, rental car savings and digital Costco Shop Card rewards.

item.title: Sergio Garcia destroys his driver in frustration at the Masters, receives code of conduct warning
item.summary: Sergio Garcia shattered his driver and received a code of conduct warning at Augusta after hitting into a bunker during the Masters final round.

item.title: Trump details sweeping 'all or nothing' blockade of Strait of Hormuz after failed Iran talks
item.summary: In a Maria Bartiromo exclusive, Trump vows to choke off Iran's oil profits with a sweeping U.S. Navy blockade of the Strait of Hormuz region.

item.title: Iran talks done in by Tehran's delusions over leverage they don't have, US official says
item.summary: Iran-U.S. negotiations fell apart after Tehran misjudged its leverage, a U.S. official says, as Vice President JD Vance departed Pakistan without a deal.

item.title: Conservative group launches $5M ad blitz pressuring Senate on voter ID as GOP eyes SAVE America Act push
item.summary: Conservative nonprofit Restoration of America launches a $5 million nationwide ad campaign urging senators to pass the SAVE America Act on voter ID rules.

item.title: ROBERT MAGINNIS: Why Islamabad talks were always doomed to fail
item.summary: VP JD Vance led historic U.S.-Iran talks in Islamabad, but after 21 hours of negotiations, the two sides failed to reach an agreement on key demands.

item.title: World Series champ Phil Garner dead at 76 after cancer battle
item.summary: Former MLB All-Star Phil Garner, a World Series champion as a player and manager of three teams, died at 76 after a pancreatic cancer battle.

item.title: NASA's Artemis follow-up mission 'right around the corner' after successful lunar flight
item.summary: NASA targets the moon's south pole for a future base as Artemis III prepares to test critical docking maneuvers in Earth's orbit launching next year.
